entityCoordinates.runtimeConversion: Use the scene origin/axis conversion supplied by the renderer; gameplay imports do not modify original coordinates.

localization.layout: Each language has two fields: text and stage direction; original empty text is retained, no silent fallback.

unrecognizedSourceCommands.implementation: runtime-owned; catalog does not imply support

unrecognizedSourceCommands.name: SuccessQuest
unrecognizedSourceCommands.implementation: runtime-owned; catalog does not imply support

world.initialStateCaveat: Serialized source values are exported; loading, template inheritance, script initialization and savegame overrides must be interpreted before claiming a new-game state.

scope: Original full quest/info/localization catalog and serialized world gameplay metadata. Native code semantics, combat, AI and streaming require separate runtime implementations.

transport.integrity: Validate raw compressed and decoded SHA256/bytes when wire bytes are available; HTTP-transparent gzip routes validate the bounded decoded receipt before JSON use.
transport.enums: Decoded enum values are numeric; names/types/symbols and exact bytes remain in the local audit.
transport.worldChunks: Source descriptors reference ordered chunks of at most256 gameplay entities; geometry-only entities stay in the index.

enumLabelPolicy.labels: Community g3dit reference labels are unverified for this installed native build.
enumLabelPolicy.authoritative: Original numeric enum values; never dispatch native behavior by community symbol strings.
